reason: 50,000 دج is more than a month of what I earn, and I can post on Facebook for free. I need the money soon, so I'm not going to pay up front for a video with no promise it sells.
objection: No contract and just 'word and trust'. If I pay 50,000 and nothing sells, who do I ask? And why would a hotel catalogue bring serious buyers?
would_change_my_mind: Only the commission option with nothing paid up front, with a clear written promise of how fast they publish, and proof they've sold properties in El Oued before.
